quickAnswer: For several LinkedIn senders sharing campaigns and an inbox, start with HeyReach. Compare Dripify and Expandi for LinkedIn and email sequences. Linked Helper has the lowest entry price here, but you must keep its desktop app running. Waalaxy suits prebuilt campaigns; its Inbox costs extra. Choose around reply handling, team access and the full bill.

providers.name: Dripify
providers.fit: LinkedIn and email sequences for a small team
providers.catch: The team owner needs Advanced. Each sending account adds a paid seat.
providers.costNote: Team controls included; all senders on this tier.
providers.good: LinkedIn and email steps, a dedicated inbox and CSV export cover the everyday campaign work. Replies pause the sequence. Advanced adds team management, shared templates and filtering to help keep teammates from targeting the same people.
providers.weak: Pro and Advanced each include 100 successful email-find or verification credits per month. Extra data costs more, and each connected LinkedIn account needs a paid seat.
providers.price: Pro is $79 per seat monthly; Advanced is $99. Annual billing lowers the monthly equivalents to $59 and $79, paid as $708 or $948 per seat upfront. Extra email credits start at $29 for 1,000. Team members can use Pro while the owner uses Advanced: that mix costs $257 for three senders or $415 for five per month.
providers.verdict: Pro covers standard solo outreach. Give the team owner Advanced and keep other senders on Pro unless they need the extra features. Upgrading every rep just for management access wastes money.

providers.name: Expandi
providers.catch: Personalised images and video cost extra. Agency controls need a quote.
providers.good: Conditional sequences let you change the next step based on prospect activity. Business includes LinkedIn and email campaigns, an inbox, tags and CSV export. Workspace collaborators can join without buying another sending seat. Detected replies pause campaign activity.
providers.weak: Image, GIF and video personalisation add subscriptions. White label and advanced Agency controls sit behind custom pricing. Purchased seats remain billable when an account is disconnected; reduce the paid seat count to reduce the next bill.
providers.price: Business is $99 per LinkedIn account monthly. Agency pricing is by quote for 10 or more seats. The vendor advertises a $79 monthly equivalent on annual billing in its prospecting guide.
providers.priceIssue: The pricing page uses both “20% off” and “2 months free” for annual billing. Those produce different totals. Get the annual invoice amount before committing.
providers.verdict: Expandi is expensive for basic connection requests and follow-ups. Conditional sequences can justify the fee. Buy image or video personalisation only when it helps your team start better conversations.

providers.name: HeyReach
providers.fit: Several senders sharing campaigns and replies
providers.catch: Email sending needs another platform. Inbox access covers the whole workspace.
providers.costNote: Teammates are free; charge is per sender.
providers.good: Multiple LinkedIn accounts can share a campaign, with conversations brought into one inbox. Teammates can handle replies without another sender charge. Replies end the sequence. Workspace exclusion rules can prevent repeat outreach across campaigns and senders.
providers.weak: Email campaigns depend on an integration such as Instantly or Smartlead. Inbox permission exposes the workspace's conversations, so check access before adding clients or contractors. The included 100 enrichment credits per sender are a one-time allocation. CSV exports omit custom variables.
providers.price: Growth is $79 per sender monthly for one to nine senders, dropping to $59 from ten. The annual offer displays $759 billed yearly for one sender; its $64 monthly label is rounded.
providers.priceIssue: The cancellation help says you can cancel any time. The terms specify 30 days' written notice unless the Order Form says otherwise. Have the applicable renewal notice confirmed before paying.
providers.verdict: Shared campaigns and one inbox give a team a clear reason to pay. Growth covers a few senders well. Move to Agency when you need its client-management features or the sender bundle lowers your total cost.

providers.name: Waalaxy
providers.catch: Inbox is extra. A team must use the same plan and billing term.
providers.good: Prebuilt sequences make setup straightforward. Business combines LinkedIn and email, includes 500 monthly email-finder credits and supports CSV import and export. Team duplicate checks help prevent overlap. Campaigns now run in the cloud, with the browser closed.
providers.weak: Inbox is a paid add-on and cannot be bought for just one member of a team. All team seats share the same tier and billing term. Unused finder credits expire.
providers.price: Business lists a standard monthly rate of €139 per seat, which can vary by country. Inbox adds €20, bringing the total to €159. Annual Business costs €828 per seat plus €120 for Inbox: €948 upfront. LinkedIn-focused Advanced costs €588 annually before Inbox. A 10% discount code is available from five seats; Inbox eligibility is unspecified.
providers.verdict: Business plus Inbox is expensive for basic outreach. Choose Advanced for LinkedIn-only work. The higher tier earns its price when you need integrated email; paying for Inbox across unused seats is poor value.

providers.name: Linked Helper
providers.fit: A low-cost setup with hands-on management
providers.runtime: Desktop app or your own VPS
providers.catch: The machine must keep running. Standard limits advanced actions.
providers.costNote: One licence per active LinkedIn account.
providers.good: Standard supports sequences, reply checks and lead exports at a low price. You can build detailed workflows and check list overlap before launch.
providers.weak: Your computer or VPS must stay on. Standard limits advanced actions, including CRM and webhook sends, to 20 profiles a day; message-history export requires Pro. Reply checks run on a schedule, so setup affects how quickly the workflow stops. The cloud-storage option still requires your own running app.
providers.price: Standard Local is $15 monthly or $99 paid annually. Pro Local is $45 monthly or $297 annually. Optional cloud storage raises the monthly prices to $29.90 and $59.90. Budget separately for a VPS if you need one.
providers.verdict: Good value at $15 if someone will maintain the app. Without that owner, missed runs and cleanup can outweigh the saving. Upgrade to Pro for a specific export or CRM requirement.

providers.name: STACKED / Dux-Soup
providers.fit: Local or cloud campaigns with shared team options
providers.runtime: Local app or paid cloud execution
providers.catch: Cloud costs more. Old Dux-Soup extension reviews describe retired products.
providers.costNote: Cloud Fixed Seats cost $99 per sender.
providers.good: STACKED, powered by Dux-Soup, offers drip campaigns, CSV export and reply management. Fixed Seat teams with at least two seats can use shared campaigns and duplicate controls. Non-sending administrators do not consume a paid seat. Cloud execution can run without your machine staying on.
providers.weak: Fixed and Flexible plans have different team features and seat rules. Email finding uses separate credits. Older reviews of the retired Pro, Turbo and Cloud extensions describe a different product.
providers.price: Fixed Seats cost $55 per sender monthly for local execution or $99 for cloud. Annual prices are $495 local or $890 cloud per seat upfront. The five-seat Flexible cloud package costs $371 monthly, compared with $495 for five Fixed cloud seats.
providers.verdict: The $124 monthly premium for five Fixed cloud seats needs a specific reason. Pay it when shared-campaign controls save your team work. Otherwise, compare the Flexible package before committing.

providers.name: Meet Alfred
providers.fit: LinkedIn and email outreach with CSV workflows
providers.catch: The entry plan omits exports and integrations. Agency has a three-seat minimum.
providers.good: Multi-Channel combines LinkedIn and email with CSV imports, exports and integrations. Agency adds team roles, a collaborative inbox and native HubSpot and Salesforce integrations. Cloud execution keeps campaigns running without an open browser.
providers.weak: LinkedIn Only excludes Sales Navigator support, InMail, exports and integrations. Replies normally pause a sequence, but a reply during a chained LinkedIn message step does not stop the remaining messages in that step.
providers.price: Current plan documentation lists LinkedIn Only at $59 per seat monthly, Multi-Channel at $69 and Agency at $79 with a three-seat minimum. Annual equivalents are $39, $49 and $59: $468, $588 or $708 per seat upfront. The minimum annual Agency purchase is $2,124.
providers.priceIssue: The pricing page and current help article show different plan labels and amounts. These figures follow the current plan article. Confirm the selected tier at checkout.
providers.verdict: Multi-Channel is the practical choice for moving lead data in and out. Agency is poor value for a solo seller paying its three-seat minimum. Avoid chained messages when a reply should stop the whole sequence.

providers.name: PhantomBuster
providers.fit: Data collection and connected automation workflows
providers.catch: Shared running time limits capacity. Separate workflows do not share state.
providers.good: PhantomBuster combines data extraction and outreach workflows, with CSV and JSON export on paid plans. Several connected accounts can share a workspace. Cloud execution runs with your browser closed.
providers.weak: Budgeting requires an estimate of how long your workflows run. Running out of time pauses execution. Separate workflows do not share state, which can create overlapping messages. Its LinkedIn Outreach workflow uses two slots, and existing connections need a different workflow.
providers.price: Monthly workspace plans are Start $69, Grow $159 and Scale $439. They include 20, 80 and 300 execution hours, with 5, 15 and 50 automation slots. Annual upfront prices are $672, $1,536 and $4,224. Included monthly email credits are 500, 2,500 and 10,000. These are shared workspace allowances.
providers.verdict: Useful for a defined data task with someone to run it. A team that mainly needs an outreach queue and inbox will get a simpler setup elsewhere. A Scale subscription needs enough productive work to justify $439 a month.

LINKEDIN AUTOMATION: FIVE TRIAL CHECKS

1. REPLY: Send a reply from a test contact. Confirm the next automated message stops.
2. DUPLICATE: Add the same test contact to two senders. Check the exclusion settings prevent overlapping outreach.
3. HANDOFF: Assign the conversation to a teammate. Confirm they can see the context and next action.
4. EXPORT: Export a sample. Open it and check names, profile URLs, status and the message history you need.
5. BILL: Record the full monthly cost, paid seats, extra tools and renewal deadline.

faqs.q: What is the best LinkedIn automation tool for a small sales team?
faqs.a: Start with HeyReach when several senders need shared campaigns and an inbox. Compare Dripify and Expandi for LinkedIn plus email. Linked Helper suits a tighter budget when someone can manage the desktop app. Test how your shortlisted tool handles replies and team handoffs.

faqs.q: How much do LinkedIn automation tools cost?
faqs.a: In this comparison, monthly per-sender examples range from $15 for Linked Helper Standard Local to $99 for Dripify Advanced or Expandi Business. Waalaxy Business plus Inbox is €159 per sender at its standard monthly list rate. PhantomBuster starts at $69 per shared workspace with usage limits. LinkedIn subscriptions, tax and extra services are separate.

faqs.q: Do I need LinkedIn Sales Navigator to use these tools?
faqs.a: Ordinary outreach can work with a free LinkedIn account on several tools here, including Dripify, Expandi, HeyReach and Waalaxy. Sales Navigator is a separate subscription for research and certain features. Check the specific import or InMail workflow before buying it. Meet Alfred's entry plan excludes Sales Navigator support.

faqs.q: Is LinkedIn automation allowed by LinkedIn?
faqs.a: LinkedIn prohibits unauthorised software that scrapes data or automates activity on its site, and accounts can be restricted. Cloud hosting, a dedicated IP or a vendor's safety claim does not grant LinkedIn permission. Review the platform's rules before connecting an account.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Dripify, Expandi and HeyReach?
faqs.a: Dripify combines LinkedIn and email sequences with a team-management upgrade. Expandi offers conditional campaign paths and paid personalisation options. HeyReach centres on several LinkedIn senders sharing campaigns and replies; email sending uses another platform.

faqs.q: Do LinkedIn automation tools stop messages when someone replies?
faqs.a: Many tools pause or end sequences after detecting a reply, but the details differ. Linked Helper uses scheduled reply checks. Meet Alfred's chained-message step can continue sending messages within that step after a reply. Test the exact sequence before launching it.

faqs.q: Is Dux-Soup still a browser extension?
faqs.a: Dux-Soup replaced its Pro, Turbo and Cloud extensions with STACKED. The current product uses a desktop application and offers either local execution or paid cloud execution.

faqs.q: How can cold calling support a LinkedIn campaign?
faqs.a: Use LinkedIn to understand the person's role and the business context. Match the prospect to a usable phone number, call with a relevant question and record the outcome in your CRM. Update automated follow-ups after the conversation. Compare qualified conversations and held meetings per target account to see whether adding calls improves the campaign.
